_doc: Hoja de animación de un personaje: 4 fotogramas en cuadrícula 2×2, mismo personaje, misma escala, de lado mirando a la derecha. El nombre dice quién es; --details, la secuencia fotograma a fotograma. Referencias: el sprite de lado del héroe (pose y escala) y su figura de cuerpo entero (identidad).
subject: an animation sprite sheet of {name}: exactly 4 frames of the SAME character arranged in a 2x2 grid (frame 1 top-left, frame 2 top-right, frame 3 bottom-left, frame 4 bottom-right){details}
pose: strict side view, the character faces the RIGHT side of the image in all four frames, one frame per grid cell, each cell showing the whole body
mandatory: EXACTLY 4 frames in a 2x2 grid of four equal cells. No more, no fewer.
The SAME character in every frame: identical face, hair, armour, cape, colours and proportions. Only the pose changes.
Same scale in every frame; the feet rest on the same invisible baseline near the bottom of each cell.
Each figure is fully inside its own cell with clear empty margin on all sides; figures in different cells never touch or overlap.
NO grid lines, NO borders, NO frames, NO numbers, NO labels between or around the cells.
The character faces RIGHT in all frames. Strict side profile.
Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), perfectly uniform, in every cell.
No scenery, no ground, no floor line, no cast shadow, no motion lines, no slash effects, no dust.
